project.name: quelorax-backend-microservices
project.description: Aggregator (reactor) POM only — NOT a parent POM. Each module below keeps its own independent Spring Boot parent (spring-boot-starter-parent), so they stay fully standalone, deployable, and buildable on their own. This file exists purely so the whole microservices folder can be imported into Eclipse/IntelliJ in one action, and so `mvn clean install` from this folder builds all four services in the right dependency order.
